Container.Name: Euro-Office
Container.Overview:
Euro-Office Document Server (OnlyOffice-based) - alternative web office backend for OpenCloud 7.5+.
MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with Collabora: both use the same collaboration (WOPI) service inside OpenCloud. Run only ONE.
On the OpenCloud container set COLLABORATION_APP_NAME=Euro-Office, COLLABORATION_APP_PRODUCT=OnlyOffice, COLLABORATION_APP_PROOF_DISABLE=true, and mount app-registry.yaml.
Container.Requires: Requires OpenCloud 7.5+ with OC_ADD_RUN_SERVICES containing 'collaboration'. Do not run alongside Collabora.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: Euro-Office HTTP port (proxied by SWAG on your euro-office subdomain)

Config.Name: WOPI_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable WOPI mode. Must be true for OpenCloud.

Config.Name: JWT_SECRET
Config.Description: JWT secret. Use the value generated by the pre-install script (config/euro-office-jwt-secret.txt).

Config.Name: USE_UNAUTHORIZED_STORAGE
Config.Description: Set true only if OpenCloud uses self-signed certificates.
